sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.10866 of 2023
Order:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. by the petitioner/Accused seeking bail in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No.52 of 2023, on the file of Rudrangi Police Station, Rajanna Sircilla District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 354-C, 376 and 509 of IPC and Section 67 and 67 (a) of IT Act.

entities.text: Rudrangi Police Station, Rajanna Sircilla District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State and perused the record.
3.
The Police registered the present crime on the basis of the complaint given by the husband of the alleged victim.
It is stated that some unknown persons were sending abusive messages to his wife.
Later his wife let to Dubai, even then, she was receiving messages.

4. Learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that there are money transactions in between the complainant and the petitioner, for which reason, a false complaint has been filed.
5. On instructions, learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that Police have not seized any phone showing that abusive messages alleged to have sent by this petitioner.
6. If there are no abusive messages or photographs, the question of attracting offences against this petitioner does not arise.

However, in the event of Police issuing notice under Section 41-A Cr.P.C,
and since the offences alleged are less than 7 years, the Police are directed to strictly follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further, the Police shall also consider the background of money transactions in between the parties.
operate with the Investigating Officer and shall appear before the Investigating officer as and when required for the purpose of investigation.
7. With the said observation, this Criminal Petition is disposed off.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending in this criminal petition, shall stand closed.

K.SURENDER, J Date : 14.11.2023 dv (2014) 8 SCC 273 Thikka Bhoomaiah vs State Of Telangana on 14 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168239981/
